name: Camp Outright
description_short: A one-week overnight summer camp in Vermont for LGBTQ+ and allied youth ages 13-17, run by Outright Vermont. Campers stay in rustic cabins and pick their own activities, including nature activities, arts, sports and social justice workshops.
special_needs_notes: An onsite Wellness Team from UVM Medical Center (two medical residents and a nurse, supervised by a pediatric specialist) is at camp. Three licensed mental health providers are also there, but this is not a therapeutic camp. Medications are kept locked and handed out by medical staff. Allergens are labeled at meals, with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swimming is in a pond and is optional. Two certified lifeguards plus other staff always supervise. Campers must pass a swim test before going past the roped-off shallow end. Swimwear must cover the chest.

sources.note: Camp Outright page: 2026 Session 1 July 3-9, Session 2 July 11-17; ages 13-17; full tuition $1,400, no camper turned away for cost; FAQ on meals, wellness team, pond swimming; CampBrain application link. Campsite town not named; only Outright's PO Box 5235, Burlington, VT 05402.

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (July 3-17, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 dates, prices or application window are posted yet.
Applications for 2026 are listed as closed.
Tuition is $1,400, but scholarships can lower it to nothing, with no paperwork. The page does not say if 2027 tuition will change.
The only address given is Outright Vermont's PO Box in Burlington. The page does not say where the campsite is.
Transportation is not a camp-run service. The camp helps arrange carpools for in-state families, and volunteers drive campers from Burlington airport (BTV).
There is no deposit when you apply. Tuition can be paid in installments, as long as it is paid in full by the start of camp.
